correctness.rationale: The first accepted particle forces a two-outcome race; independent proposal streams and the first opposite-color arrival within the initial part give the integral and finite binomial law. A common-clock argument yields the weak mixture. A centered-binomial fourth-moment bound proves the \(3/(8n)\) coefficient with \(O(n^{-2})\) residual. An independent Markov recursion matched 290 small graph/parameter laws, 1169 exact assertions; finite enumeration was not used as an infinite proof.
